name: Sallie Mae
why: Largest U.S. private student lender; dossier already green.

name: Toyota Financial Services
why: Largest captive auto lender by accounts (Toyota and Lexus loans and leases).

name: Ally Auto
why: Largest U.S. bank auto lender by originations.

name: GM Financial
why: Major captive auto lender for Chevrolet, Buick, GMC and Cadillac. Picked over Capital One Auto Finance, whose public help pages do not cover auto-loan payments.

name: Ford Credit
why: Major captive auto lender for Ford and Lincoln loans and leases; has public Guest Pay.

name: Santander Consumer USA
why: One of the largest non-captive auto lenders (also services Chrysler Capital).

name: MOHELA (Federal Student Aid)
why: Largest federal student loan servicer. Nelnet and Aidvantage were considered, but their public help pages only load with scripts and could not be read.

name: OneMain Financial
why: Largest U.S. personal installment lender with a national branch network.

name: SoFi
why: Leading online personal loan and student loan refinance lender.

name: Discover Personal Loans
why: Large national personal loan servicer. Picked over Affirm, whose help center only loads with scripts and could not be read.
